'''Ruth Leslie Goodman''' (born 1961) is an American writer of [[romance novels]] who uses the [[pen name]] '''Meagan McKinney'''.

== Education ==
Goodman studied biology at [[Columbia University]].<ref name=":0" />

== Career ==
Goodman's career began as a biologist for several years. Goodman became a writer professionally and used the pen name Meagan McKinney.

Goodman's first book, ''My Wicked Enchantress'', was a finalist for a [[Romance Writers of America#Golden Medallion|Romance Writers of America Golden Medallion]].<ref name=":0" />

== Personal life ==
Goodman is divorced and resides with her two children in [[New Orleans, Louisiana]]. In November 2010, Goodman pleaded guilty to defrauding [[FEMA]] in the wake of [[Hurricane Katrina]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |author=Perlstein |first=Michael |date=November 11, 2011 |title=Garden District romance novelist pleads guilty to Katrina fraud |url=https://www.wwltv.com/article/news/garden-district-romance-novelist-pleads-guilty-to-katrina-fraud/289-347547803 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220607025245/https://www.wwltv.com/article/news/garden-district-romance-novelist-pleads-guilty-to-katrina-fraud/289-347547803 |archive-date=June 7, 2022 |access-date=June 26, 2014 |publisher=[[WWL-TV]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |author=US Attorney's Office |date=August 26, 2010 |title=Twenty-Two Individuals Charged with Fraud Related to the Recovery of Funds Following Hurricane Katrina |url=https://www.fbi.gov/neworleans/press-releases/2010/no082610a.htm |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171210071530/https://archives.fbi.gov/archives/neworleans/press-releases/2010/no082610a.htm |archive-date=December 10, 2017 |publisher=[[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] |accessdate=June 26, 2014}}</ref> She was sentenced to 3 years in prison.<ref>{{Cite news |author=Perlstein |first=Mike |date=February 25, 2011 |title=Garden District novelist sentenced in FEMA fraud |url=https://www.wwltv.com/article/news/garden-district-novelist-sentenced-in-fema-fraud/289-346912586 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220607025322/https://www.wwltv.com/article/news/garden-district-novelist-sentenced-in-fema-fraud/289-346912586 |archive-date=June 7, 2022 |access-date=June 26, 2014 |publisher=[[WWL-TV]]}}</ref>
